label: copy-phase input t (or g), late in the copy
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, only when the fed-back input is t (85% of mass) or g (15%), and only at recall_idx >= 3 (t >= 8, so L >= 5; rate rises with L and is highest at L=9). Never fires in the original phase, on <DEL>, or on any other input token. Necessary conditions only: under 2% of copy-phase t/g steps cross the threshold. Largest activations come when t follows i in the copy (e.g. ... i [t] z ...); prev_tok == i gives 11x lift and about a third of the mass, and out_tok z is also enriched. Adding those context conditions did not get F1 past ~0.26, so the selectivity within t/g steps is left unexplained.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=g (+4.81), phase=2 & in_tok=t (+4.50), prev_tok=i (+3.65), phase=2 & out_tok=z (+2.53), in_tok=t (+2.47), prev_tok=r (+2.12). Lower it: prev2_tok=<DEL> (-1.93), recall_idx=2 (-1.93), orig8=- (-1.86), out_tok=y (-1.85).
